test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: WF 18 is related to ZI 13 in a certain way. In the same way. NT 16 is related to QW 11. To which of the following is SL 19 related following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5586bf39778a5d62b47c705426cb37e4f39b34b051905bd7d1846c4a6fd56df8.png] ​

**Logic: Addition of 3 to the positional value of the first and second alphabet and 5 is subtracted from the number.**

WF 18 is related to ZI 13 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18ef253ca3251267aba6537381a431fcc40b2a7179444d67123abc3ae4021d4c.png] 

NT 16 is related to QW 11 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/874baebe36202019dfc4c6b4826d8c10e2e5594dfd0a3c65f66ecc964a715c3a.png] 

Similarly, SL 19 will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/567d8a162935c8749fa92ed39cee3f2673b8bf146b0a30f19fcfe3eaf8a6891f.png] 

Here, 'SL 19' is related to** 'VO 14'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
